info.name: Sygnal — UC4 Separate-HIS Escalation to CARE (T1 HCM→ComEMR, T2 ComEMR→CARE)
info.description:
### Quick-start: environment setup

1. Import this use case's **`*_Dev.postman_environment.json`** (in the same
   `reference-flows/` folder) into Postman (Environments → Import). Each use case
   ships a self-contained environment — Postman allows only one active environment
   at a time, so per-UC envs avoid one ever-growing shared file.
2. Select that environment from the picker.
3. Set `bpp_uri`, `bap_uri`, and `auth_token` for your sandbox. `bpp_uri` is the target
   base URL and switches by transaction (ComEMR for T1, HCM for UC3, CARE for UC4-T2).
4. `network_id` is `example.net/health` (STUB) — confirm with the registry team.
5. Subscriber IDs (`hcm_np_id`, `comemr_np_id`, `care_np_id`) and all keys are STUBBED.

**Envelope note:** `context.version` is `2.0.0` — the Beckn *core message* version (a
const in beckn.yaml). The domain schema packs (HealthReferral / ServiceCoordination)
are v2.1; that shows up in the `@context` URLs, not the envelope.

## Sygnal — UC4 · Separate-HIS Escalation to CARE

**Scenario:** Same upward fever referral as UC1, but the escalation PHU runs a **separate
system (CARE)**. ComEMR — already the care coordinator — initiates a genuine second
on-network transaction to CARE and relays progress back to DIGIT HCM.

**Transactions:**
- **T1 = DIGIT HCM → ComEMR** — the upward referral (`HealthReferral`). `coordinationId` = Referral ID.
- **T2 = ComEMR → CARE** — a `HealthContract` booking. `coordinationRef` carries the T1 Referral ID;
  the T2 contract id becomes T1's `targetBookingRef`.

**Status chaining:** CARE's T2 `on_status` / `on_update` are relayed by ComEMR into T1
`update` / `on_status`, so HCM (the original referrer) sees provider-side progress. Same schema
pack applied across two hops — no additional schema.

**Cross-link (load-bearing):** `coordination_id_uc4` (T1) ↔ `booking_id_uc4` (T2). Keep both
identical to their values across the T1, T2, and Relay folders.

variable.description: STUB — confirm exact value with the network registry team.
Target base URL. Switch per transaction (ComEMR for T1; HCM for UC3; CARE for UC4-T2).
Caller callback base URL for on_* simulations.
UC4 T1 Referral ID; carried into T2 as coordinationRef.
UC4 T2 (CARE) booking id = T1 targetBookingRef.

item.name: T1 · Referral Coordination  (BAP DIGIT HCM → BPP ComEMR)
item.description: Upstream referral. coordinationId = Referral ID, carried into T2.

request.description: HCM opens the upward referral to ComEMR (directed).
ComEMR assigns the Referral ID.
Binding intent.
Draft echoed.
Confirm with consent + referral note.
ComEMR accepts. The escalation PHU runs a SEPARATE system (CARE) → ComEMR initiates a genuine on-network T2.

item.name: T2 · PHU Booking on CARE  (BAP ComEMR → BPP CARE)
item.description: Second on-network hop to the external PHU HIS. HealthContract booking; coordinationRef carries the Referral ID.

request.description: ComEMR (now Seeker NP) discovers the escalation PHU on CARE. Broadcast — no bppId.
CARE returns its PHU offer.
ComEMR books CARE. HealthContract booking carrying coordinationRef = the T1 Referral ID, plus the referral note as an inputArtifact.
CARE assigns the booking id (= T1 targetBookingRef).
Binding intent.
Draft echoed.
ComEMR confirms the PHU booking on CARE.
CARE accepts. booking_id_uc4 is the T2 contract id; ComEMR records it as the T1 targetBookingRef.

item.name: Relay · CARE progress → T1 status chain
item.description: ComEMR relays CARE's T2 on_status/on_update back into T1 so the original referrer (HCM) sees provider-side progress.

request.description: CARE reports provider-side progress on T2 (child attended the PHU).
ComEMR relays CARE progress into T1 and sets targetBookingRef = the CARE booking id, so HCM (original referrer) sees the downstream hop.
Ack.
CARE returns the PHU outcome note on T2.
ComEMR relays CARE's outcome into T1 status/update — the two-transaction status chain.
Terminal ack; T1 closed.
